candidate.description: Routing rules for workspace preview service destination prediction
candidate.body:
For this preview service only:

Observed rules:
1. Sealed records: if sealed==false is false (sealed==true), destination is sealed-946bce/<KIND>/<id> where <id> is verbatim input id. Date is ignored.
2. Unsealed records: if sealed==false, destination is store-e956f5/<YYYY>/<MM>/<KIND>/<id> where <YYYY>/<MM> are year/month split from date YYYY-MM-DD, <id> verbatim. Day of month is ignored (2031-03-19 and 2031-03-20 map to same 2031/03 prefix).
3. Kind mapping observed: invoice->9baaf2, memo->8987d9, notice->04fa80. This token appears as 3rd segment for unsealed, 2nd segment for sealed.
4. Prefixes store-e956f5 and sealed-946bce were constant in all observations.
5. Id variations do not change structure: different lengths and values (a, ZZZZZZZZZZ, AAAAAAAzAz, 003f41cbAz, 003f41cbBz) all appended verbatim.

Uncertainty / Do not assume:
- Only kinds invoice, memo, notice observed. Behavior for other kind strings is unknown; do not guess mapping. Return UNKNOWN if kind outside this set.
- Only dates in YYYY-MM-DD form observed. Malformed dates, other formats, or missing date behavior unknown.
- Prefix hashes e956f5 / 946bce and kind hashes may be deployment-specific; do not reuse for other services.
- No evidence about case sensitivity, whitespace, null/missing fields. Treat atypical inputs as UNKNOWN.
